The browser scenario 'гость со страницы 500' in web/tests/e2e/59-about-contact.spec.ts submits the /contact?requestId=t059-request-id form against the live database, reads the support_requests row back through Prisma, asserts requestId = 't059-request-id', topic 'general' and userId null, and asserts that the number shown on screen equals the stored ticketNo. CI run 35569778630 on the tested SHA.
